title: IVG Savr 3000 Strawberry Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Ice IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods offer a classic fruit-meets-ice profile, blending sweet, ripe Strawberry with a light Menthol finish. The result is bright and familiar — a great option for vapers who enjoy smooth, cooling fruit flavours. The prefilled 2ml pod connects to a 4ml refill reservoir, which automatically feeds the pod to support up to 3000 puffs depending on usage. No refilling or coil changes required. The mesh coil design delivers smooth vapour and consistent taste throughout, tailored for mouth-to-lung vaping. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
